title: Admetec Introduces PLUS Family Dental Loupe Headlights
html:
Admetec Announces Butterfly EVO+ and Orchid+ Headlights Delivering Up to 200,000 LUX

Admetec, a leader in custom-fitted optical magnification loupes, today announced the PLUS Family, a new series of high-output, lightweight headlight attachments for loupes. The company designed two new lights, the Butterfly EVO+ and Orchid+. These are the first headlights specifically manufactured for high-magnification loupes.

  • Butterfly EVO+ (wireless): Delivers up to 140,000 LUX with a focused 95-mm beam at a 500-mm working distance. It weighs 29 grams with its battery pack and provides up to 4.5 hours of continuous runtime.
  • Orchid+ (wired): Delivers up to 200,000 LUX with a tight beam tailored to high-magnification focal points. It weighs 11 grams. The wired battery unit provides up to 25 hours of runtime.

“Clinicians who know the Butterfly will feel right at home: the same touch-sensitive controls and two intensity settings,” said Dr. Roger Serrano, a dental surgeon in Tuxtla Gutiérrez, Chiapas, Mexico, and an early user of the PLUS Family products. “What’s changed is the output. Even at the same setting and with the same loupes, the EVO+ delivers a major improvement in how the light concentrates on the working field.”

One study found that more than 60% of dental professionals experience some form of musculoskeletal discomfort linked to poor posture at work. The Butterfly EVO+ and Orchid+ are designed to pair with ergonomic loupes that not only improve the experience for dentists and clinicians but also help protect their health.

“As more dentists and surgeons switch to ergonomic loupes to protect their posture, they’re running into a problem: darker fields from the enhanced magnification,” said David Kotler, head of marketing at Admetec. “The PLUS Family of headlights fixes this problem. Now there is no compromising; users can experience both comfort and the appropriate amount of illumination and magnification.”

“Admetec is the leading innovator in loupes and lighting worldwide, and we are excited to bring the PLUS Family to North America,” said Sandi Wright, CEO of Andau Medical. “We know these lights will be very well received by our dental, hygiene, and surgical customers.”

The PLUS Family is now available for purchase through Admetec’s North American distribution partner, Andau Medical.

About Admetec

Admetec is a global leader in ergonomic vision solutions, designing and handcrafting custom loupes, advanced deflection optics, and precision LED lighting systems for healthcare professionals in more than 60 countries.

About Andau Medical

Andau Medical is a medical and dental device distributor focused on providing the U.S. and Canadian markets with innovative, high-quality technologies that support clinicians in their quest to deliver exceptional patient care.
